terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: Observed square headlamp, navy leg shield, short saddle and long rear rack govern reconstruction. See image-analysis.md for the macro-to-micro inventory and hidden-side limits.

reasoning: Thin spoked wheels, open rack, compound curved leg shield, engine hardware and steering make this a complex mechanical assembly. Physical subassemblies must be consolidated into the eight submission limit.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Choose simple/moderate/complex/ultra-complex from observed structure, not from a hardcoded domain.

details.description: Broad curved leg shield wraps the steering column and leaves an open step-through
Curved low frame spine rises toward the short saddle
Rounded short vinyl saddle with perimeter seam and shallow cushion depression
Paired tapered white bands follow shield and side-cover contours
Curved narrow rear mudguard follows tyre with mudflap behind
Rounded crowned front mudguard with white leading accent
Rectangular headlamp with rolled bezel, side amber indicators
Short ribbed grips at bar ends
Silver thin rolled rims surround open spoke field
Matching rear rim, dark narrow tyre
Rear luggage rack has open rails and a genuinely slotted carrier
Rounded metallic clutch case and horizontally canted finned cylinder
Near-side chain loop joins engine sprocket to rear hub
Tall bent metallic stalks with thin oval mirror discs

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: Final evidence-backed fidelity must be strictly greater than 0.92, with every critical feature passing and every mandatory pass accepted.
Match the step-through opening, shield contours, thin spoked wheels, square lamp, short saddle, long rack and navy-white livery in the supplied plate.
Measured runtime must remain within 4000 triangles, 8 draw calls, 4 materials and 8 unique geometries; retain root, steering and wheel axle articulation without destruction groups.
Capture a four-angle turntable plus matched reference view, report hidden-side confidence, and pass attachment, intersection and coverage gates.

Meso features are consolidated into three material/steering batches with explicit geometry recipes; physical detail count is retained in localFeatures rather than extra draws. User authorized single-view approximation on resume; score concerns observable fidelity, with hidden surfaces reported separately.

featureGroups.name: Overall silhouette and proportions
qualityCriteria: Bounding shape, dominant curves, negative spaces, and scale relationships are explicitly described.
failureModes: model reads as a generic placeholder instead of the reference object
major proportions are guessed without evidence

featureGroups.name: Primary structure and hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Major parts, joints, seams, contact points, and parent-child relationships are named before code generation.
failureModes: large visible parts are merged into one mesh
component hierarchy is too shallow for the observed complexity

featureGroups.name: Attachment and joint correctness
qualityCriteria: Every visible child appendage, branch, limb, handle, connector, tube, cable, horn, wing, leg, or hinged part has an attachment contract with parent socket, localStart/localEnd, contact type, embed/overlap, and gap tolerance.
failureModes: child part root floats away from the parent
branch/limb/tube is centered in space instead of pivoting from its root
parent-child transform mixes world and local coordinates

featureGroups.name: Surface material response
qualityCriteria: Albedo zones, roughness, normal/bump/displacement intent, cavity dirt, edge wear, and local overrides are specified where visible.
Important materials define independent albedo, roughness, height/normal, and AO responses instead of reusing one texture for unrelated PBR channels.
Surface response is decomposed into macro, meso, and micro frequency bands with scale and amplitude tied to object scale.
failureModes: local material variation is missing or not tied to image evidence

featureGroups.name: Reference color, material, and lighting response
qualityCriteria: Material-pass names the reference-derived albedo palette, roughness variation, tactile normal/bump/displacement response, and local masks.
When a source image is available, run reference PBR extraction and require confidence >= 0.7 before treating maps as implementation-ready.
Lighting-pass names key/fill/rim or environment light, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadow behavior.
Neutral, grazing-angle, and reference-matched renders prove that surface relief survives relighting and is not painted into albedo.
failureModes: model has acceptable shape but reads as flat shaded or plastic
colors are a generic average instead of reference-observed local color zones
lighting is evenly ambient and cannot reproduce the source value range

visualDeltaChecks: local feature placement and scale delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).

mustMatch: reference-derived PBR material response at or above 0.7 confidence when source pixels are usable
niceToHave: micro scratches, stains, chips, and dirt masks

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

featureReviewTargets.name: Step-through envelope, shield, seat and wheel proportions
Spokes, square lamp, mirror stalks, rack openings and engine
Navy and white livery, rubber and metallic surface distinction

nextRequiredEvidence: Quality contract has named all required macro feature groups before code generation.
browser render screenshot from your agent's browser/screenshot tool
single side-by-side full reference/render comparison sheet
all critical semantic feature scores at or above their thresholds
self-correction review appended with action=continue before the next pass

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals, uniform roughness, tiling, and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: Far-side exhaust and controls are only inferred, confidence 0.45; do not claim exact catalogue geometry. User authorized approximation.
Underside mounts confidence 0.35; hidden panel profile confidence 0.60. Meshy is a generative proxy. User authorized approximation.
The reference proxy is merged; semantic-ID masks are required for region comparison. User authorized approximation.

reviewHistory.summary: Deterministic rejection, visual score unevaluated: starter generator ignores the grouped motorcycle reconstruction recipe, creates incorrect default extrusions and wheels, bounds below ground and scale delta 1.406. Implement the spec-defined curved shell and annular wheel blockout. Zero is an unaccepted sentinel, not a measured visual fidelity.

Deterministic rejection: silhouette IoU 0.604. Side-view evidence shows the floor spine too low, fork shroud too broad and front mudguard leading edge too low. Raise step-through spine by 0.10 m, split lower fork into two struts, raise fender leading angle 14 to 42 degrees, shorten rear side cover. Visual acceptance unevaluated because Tier 1 failed.

Tier 1 remains blocked (IoU .624): lower shield extends too far forward and profile corners remain rectangular. Refine shield stations toward z .17 at y .15, replace angular contour corners with quadratic transitions, correct rim tyre interface and redundant double rim tessellation. Acceptance remains unevaluated.

Silhouette overlay identifies the main remaining registration error: headlamp and mirrors are about 50-70 screen pixels too far forward while wheel and seat envelopes substantially overlap. Move head and bars aft 0.12 m, widen mirror span, lower mirror tips .024 m, move front axle forward .035 m and rear axle forward .02 m. Candidate is now 3860 triangles within budget. Tier 1 .6331 remains rejected; no visual acceptance score.

Head/axle correction raised silhouette IoU to .6961 with aspect and scale now inside tolerance. Remaining overlay gaps concentrate on aft shield edge, saddle nose, rack deck and mirror orientation. Shift upper shield aft .05 m, replace oval saddle with a rounded cushion profile, shorten rack and add its slotted deck. Replace overlapping rim/tyre volumes with one continuous annular lathe to address wheel self-intersection.

Blockout still rejected after five executed corrections: latest silhouette IoU .6843 versus required .85, aspect delta .0665 versus .05, and 1255 self-intersection samples remain. Requires another geometry correction; this sixth request reaches the saved per-pass ceiling. No visual quality/layer score assigned because Tier 1 failed. Draft retained at 3804 triangles, 8 draws, 3 materials, 6 geometries; no promotion.

Unscored: Tier1 still rejects IoU .6864; continuous swept tubes and convex rim cross-section reduce inside samples from 1255 to 805 and triangles from 3804 to 3420. Both wheel meshes now clean. Next correction removes internal rear-fender surfaces and seats accessory joins at physical seams.

Unscored, rejected regression: intersection samples improve to 143 but separated front/body surfaces fragment foreground and IoU falls to .521. Restore connected manufactured body shape and union overlapping volumes, preserving visible cover seams.

Unscored and rejected: body Boolean restores connected silhouette (.6826 IoU), but incorrect inward shell-edge winding yields 324 flags and excessive 8701 triangles. Correct winding and shared-normal inversion before reducing union tessellation.

Unscored: corrected shell-edge winding and inverted-normal ownership; all static metal and wheels now clean, 124 flags remain in body/steering paint. IoU .6840 and 8711 triangles still fail. Remove redundant coplanar Boolean splits without changing the exterior silhouette.

Unscored rejected: coplanar merging lowers triangles 8711 to 6020 but introduces visible holes; IoU .6711, 129 intersection flags. Remove that simplifier, reduce primitive tessellation before Boolean construction, and compute actual exterior face normals.

Unscored, still rejected at extended ceiling: reduced primitive tessellation and removed faulty planar simplifier. Current 5864 triangles exceed 4000; IoU .6793 below .85, aspect .0743 above .05. Intersection gate flags 88 of 10168 sampled vertices (16952 total) across body and steering paint; wheels and metal clean. Six additional executed rounds, no accepted pass, no >92 fidelity claim. Preserve all history; model not promoted.

Unscored: all body T-junction edges conformed (664 boundary edges to 0), isolated front fender now clean after higher tessellation and angle-weighted normals. Full assembly still 68 flagged samples and IoU .6799. Replace intersecting body primitive architecture with one continuous shaped underbone volume; Boolean cuts and thin overlapping masses are the recurring defect.

Unscored: continuous underbone replaces Boolean architecture, 5340 triangles and zero boundary edges. Isolated body two flags, assembled 38 flags mainly fork/fender overlap; IoU .6774 still fails. Next correct fork blade shape and physical side clearance, and linearize the leg-shield width transition.

Unscored: shaped fork blades at x +/- .082 replace overlapping struts; steering assembly now clean, only body 10 flagged samples remain. IoU improves to .6925 but below .85. Preserve hard panel/bevel normals rather than smoothing concave edges into the volume.

Unscored: splitting cap triangles at deformation breakpoints removes real folds; separate side covers now clear. Full self-intersection gate PASSES, 0/12614 samples. IoU .693 beauty; diagnostic exact alpha .7477, best registration only .7544. Next silhouette corrections: shorten leading fender arc, lower/back-shift saddle, and move handlebar/headlight/mirrors aft to observed proxy locations. Use paired alpha passes for blockout shape diagnostics, keeping beauty history intact.

Unscored: paired geometry-silhouette IoU .7887, aspect .0661; still below thresholds, full intersection clean. Saddle lowered .045m/back .05m, head assembly moved aft .06m/down .01m, front fender leading angle 42->55deg. Next tyre shoulder thickness and tapered rear rack correct remaining footprint differences; no threshold changes.

Unscored: tyre shoulder profile and tapered rack improve paired-alpha IoU .8038; aspect .0505 narrowly fails. Three rack deck corner samples now overlap the taper. Correct deck clearance, raise fender crown 2cm, extend leading-link fork heel and taper saddle nose to the plate.

Unscored: fender crown +2cm, leading-link heel and tapered seat improve alpha IoU .8069; intersections clean. Next correct a semantic assembly error: near side is chain drive, not exhaust. Add chain housing/loop and steering neck collar, enlarge undersized crankcase; exhaust goes to hidden opposite side.

Unscored: correct visible-side chain drive and hidden-side exhaust improve silhouette IoU .8154. Six body samples indicate chain guard overlaps side cover; lower guard 17mm. Crankcase remains too narrow/occluded relative to plate; widen to .31m with .025m lateral offset and provide frame/peg clearances.

Unscored: IoU .8216, five static metal overlap samples. Projected landmark check identifies crankcase longitudinal placement as cause of small visible cover: move center z -.055 -> .07 and restore .25m width, not further enlargement. Reposition cylinder, chain front and mounts; reduce saddle thickness with crown height preserved.

Unscored regression: .8150 IoU and 10 saddle/body overlap samples. Direct browser raycasts on proxy crankcase locate visible cover at x .08-.097, y .277-.33, z -.039-.070: root cause is painted underbone extending too low over the case, not case alone. Raise central underside, replace ellipsoid with measured flat-sided case outline, restore cylinder placement and lower seat support clear of saddle. Increase mirror mast height to declared 1.25m.

Unscored: measured case/body correction is watertight and full intersection passes; alpha IoU .8171 remains below .85 and aspect .0505 above .05. Mirror top now 1.24985m. Final available correction normalizes the actual ground/base-center pivot (current length midpoint is z .0195m), preserving all child articulation, then verifies current model and budgets.

UNSCORED sentinel: deterministic blockout failed, no accepted visual fidelity or layer scores. Round23 corrected root to exact base-center; all child articulation preserved. Paired alpha silhouette IoU 0.8034 below 0.85, aspect delta 0.0702 above 0.05, scale delta 0.0656 within 0.08. Root correction changed registration versus round22; no fidelity improvement claimed. Self-intersection 0 flagged of 13100 sampled/17096 total, 27 undecided. Turntable, attachment and multi-angle clean; pass blocked. 5912 triangles,8 draws,3 materials,6 geometries fit hero ceilings. Requires further body/proportion refinement and later material/livery work; requested quality above92 unmet. Preserve all history and obey doubled limit24/60.
